name: S-Git
description: Git client panel: multi-branch commit graph, hunk staging, side-by-side diff, merge/rebase and file log. Follows the focused workspace.

statusBarItems.tooltip: S-Git: changed files in the focused workspace

settings.title: Git executable
settings.description: Path to the git binary. Leave empty to use git from PATH. Restart the plugin after changing it.

settings.title: Commits per page
settings.description: Commits loaded per page in the graph; the next page loads with Load more. Restart the plugin after changing it.

settings.title: Refresh delay (ms)
settings.description: How long to gather changes in .git/ and the working tree before refreshing. Restart the plugin after changing it.
